decisions.reason: The quantified cost-saving result and alignment with the established offer make withdrawal unlikely, while sunk costs and public commitment reinforce persistence.
As a flagship product line central to the announced direction, its high visibility and sunk costs strongly incline the firm to maintain it despite any early disappointments.
Although it is less visibly committed and has had time without strong results, its closeness to the established business and sunk investments still support persistence under escalation.
The recent launch, several models, and own-page visibility create sunk costs and public commitment that make early withdrawal unlikely while results can still be seen as temporary.

As a newly launched product line with several models and visible presentation, the firm is likely to persist because investments are sunk and disappointing early results remain attributable to temporary causes.
